ja: 私が会議室を予約しようとした時には、彼らはもう打ち合わせの日程を変えていました。
en: When I tried to book a room, they had already rescheduled the meeting.
alternatives: By the time I tried to book a room, they'd already rescheduled the meeting.
They had already changed the meeting date when I tried to book a room.
point: 予約しようとした時より前の出来事なので had rescheduled

ja: 来週のレビュー、部長が何曜日なら空いてるか知ってる？
en: Do you know which day the manager is free for next week's review?
alternatives: Do you know what day the manager is available for next week's review?
Any idea which day the manager's free for the review next week?
point: 間接疑問は which day the manager is の語順。is を前に出さない

ja: たとえクライアントに頼まれても、私たちはリリース日をこれ以上前倒しすることはできません。
en: Even if the client asks us to, we can't move the release date up any further.
alternatives: Even if the client asks, we can't bring the release date forward any further.
We can't move up the release date any further, even if the client asks us to.
point: 「前倒し」は move up / bring forward、even if 節は現在形

ja: 私たちは納期を確認するために、明日の朝お客様に電話します。
en: We'll call the client tomorrow morning to confirm the deadline.
alternatives: We're going to call the client tomorrow morning to confirm the deadline.
We'll call the client tomorrow morning to confirm the delivery date.
point: 「〜するために」は to 不定詞で表す

ja: 今週はみんな忙しいので、ミーティングを来週に延ばすのはどうですか？
en: Since everyone's busy this week, how about pushing the meeting back to next week?
alternatives: Everyone's busy this week, so how about putting the meeting off until next week?
Since everyone's tied up this week, what about moving the meeting to next week?
point: how about の後は -ing。延期は push back や put off

ja: 部長は、月曜の締め切りに間に合わせるために週末に作業するのは避けたいと思っています。
en: Our manager wants to avoid working on the weekend to meet the Monday deadline.
alternatives: Our manager would like to avoid working over the weekend to make the Monday deadline.
Our manager wants to avoid having to work on the weekend to hit the Monday deadline.
point: avoid の後は to 不定詞ではなく -ing

ja: 先方に、打ち合わせを来週の火曜日にずらしてもらうよう頼んでもらえますか？
en: Could you ask the client to move the meeting to next Tuesday?
alternatives: Can you ask the client to push the meeting back to next Tuesday?
Could you ask the client if they could move the meeting to next Tuesday?
point: ask＋人＋to do の形。人のあとに to 不定詞を続ける

ja: 火曜の午後に予定されていたクライアントとの打ち合わせは、木曜の朝に変更になりました。
en: The client meeting scheduled for Tuesday afternoon has been moved to Thursday morning.
alternatives: The client meeting that was scheduled for Tuesday afternoon has been moved to Thursday morning.
The client meeting set for Tuesday afternoon has been pushed to Thursday morning.
point: scheduled for で後ろから修飾し、has been moved で受け身

ja: 会議が来週にずれたこと、あなたがもっと早く教えてくれていたらよかったのに。
en: I wish you had told me sooner that the meeting was moved to next week.
alternatives: If only you'd told me earlier that the meeting got moved to next week.
I wish you'd let me know sooner that the meeting was pushed to next week.
point: 過去への後悔は I wish + had 過去分詞
